MainButtonDef.label: guards
MainButtonDef.description: See your guards and assign them to guard posts or patrol routes.

PawnColumnDef.label: assignment
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Which guard posts or patrol route this guard uses.

PawnColumnDef.label: combat skill
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Shooting and Melee. The higher one is highlighted: give that guard a ranged or melee weapon to match.

PawnColumnDef.label: on-duty apparel
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: The apparel policy this guard uses on duty. While a policy is chosen here, the Guards tab keeps it set whenever the guard is on duty. "Keep current" leaves their policy alone.

PawnColumnDef.label: off-duty apparel
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: The apparel policy this guard uses off duty. While a policy is chosen here, the Guards tab keeps it set whenever the guard is off duty. "Keep current" leaves their policy alone.

PawnColumnDef.label: on-duty loadout
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: The Combat Extended loadout this guard uses on duty. While a loadout is chosen here, the Guards tab keeps it set whenever the guard is on duty. "Keep current" leaves their loadout alone.

PawnColumnDef.label: off-duty loadout
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: The Combat Extended loadout this guard uses off duty, for example non-lethal weapons for peacekeeping. While a loadout is chosen here, the Guards tab keeps it set whenever the guard is off duty. "Keep current" leaves their loadout alone.

PawnColumnDef.label: militia
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Militia members are called up with the Call militia button.

PawnColumnDef.label: militia apparel
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: The apparel policy this member switches to when the militia is called up. Standing down restores the policy they had before. "Keep current" leaves their policy alone.

PawnColumnDef.label: militia loadout
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: The loadout this member switches to when the militia is called up. Standing down restores the loadout they had before. "Keep current" leaves their loadout alone.

PawnColumnDef.label: shift
PawnColumnDef.headerTip: Paint the hours this guard is on shift. During a shift they're on duty and hold their post or walk their route, whatever their schedule says.
